task.title: Subject storage: flags.json subject, session_flags, issue binding
task.description: Plan slice 1. Add SessionFlags.subject = {kind: "pr"|"issue", repo: "owner/name", number, url, repositoryId?} to src/session/organize.ts: validated on read (invalid -> absent) and on write (refuse: url must be https://github.com/<repo>/pull/<number> for pr or /issues/<number> for issue, repo owner/name charset, positive integer number); SessionFlagsChange.subject (object, or null to unlink); writeFlags persists it. src/acp/server.ts handleSessionFlags accepts subject (object|null|omitted, refuse other types). src/session/issues/issue-session.ts withIssueBinding: when it binds the session (stage registered -> session_bound) also set flags subject {kind:"issue", repo, number, url} via setSessionFlags or equivalent, without breaking existing issue tests. Mirror the type in apps/desktop/src/acp/types.ts SessionFlags (subject?: SessionSubject; export the SessionSubject type and a helper sameSubject(a,b) comparing kind+repo(case-insensitive)+number). Tests in src/session/organize.test.ts, src/acp/shell-session-organize.test.ts and the issue-session tests: round trip, restart re-read, null unlink, refusal of invalid subject, issue binding writes subject.

acceptance_criteria: AC8: Subject storage: `_keryx/session_flags` accepts `subject` {kind "pr"|"issue", repo, number, url}, refuses an invalid one, persists it in `flags.json` so a fresh read (restart) returns it, and `null` unlinks it; an Issue session bound by `withIssueBinding` carries `subject.kind = "issue"`; when keryx replies without `subject`, Desktop still opens the session and shows a notice that the binding was not saved (spec AC8, failure scenario) [verify: exec `bun test src/session/organize.test.ts src/acp/shell-session-organize.test.ts src/session/issues`]
